title: 電子工学
subtitle: Introduction to Semiconductor Devices
teachers:
MORI Takayuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn an overview of the electronic and optical devises consisting semiconductor materials.
(2) learn basic characteristics of the pn junction diode, the bipolar junction transistor, and the field effect transistor.
(3) learn applications of semiconductor devices.
advice:
This is a basic course of semiconductor devices. We will cover the following materials:

1. Fundamentals of semiconductor materials
    Classical quantum theory
    Energy band
    Electron and hole
    n-type and p-type semiconductors
2. Fundamentals of pn junction diode
    Structure, characteristics, and applications of pn junction diode
3. Fundamentals of bipolar junction transistor (BJT)
    Structure, characteristics, and applications of BJT
4. Fundamentals of field effect transistor (FET)
    Characteristics of Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (MOS) capacitor
    Structure, characteristics, and applications of MOSFET
requiredKnowledge:
Basic knowledge of classical mechanics
Acquisition of electromagnetics I
Basic skill of mathematics (especially differential / integral)

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain an overview of the classical quantum theory and characteristics of semiconductor materials.
Be able to explain the structure, characteristics, and applications of the pn junction diode.
Be able to explain the structure, characteristics, and applications of the BJT.
Be able to explain the structure, characteristics, and applications of the MOSFET.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)Explain the detail of the structure, characteristics, and applications of the pn junction diode, the bipolar junction transistor, and the field effect transistor.
(2)Obtain the evaluation of 85%.
(3)Grow motivation to learn “Physical Electronics”, “Semiconductor Engineering”, and “Optical and Electronic Devices”.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)Explain overview of the structure, characteristics, and applications of the pn junction diode, the bipolar junction transistor, and the field effect transistor.
(2)Obtain the evaluation of 70%.
(3)Have an interest in “Physical Electronics”, “Semiconductor Engineering”, and “Optical and Electronic Devices”.
